SDC1 staged delivery: SKA1-MID AA1 L-band (30 min, SEFD noise)
SKA1-MID AA1 (8 SKA dishes, max baseline 1.4 km; sparse uv-coverage, confusion-limited) observing the SDC1 560-1400 MHz crossed catalogue (sources >= 10 uJy, real spectral indices) for 30 min in Band 2 (1.31 GHz, 720 MHz, 64 channels). Thermal noise from per-antenna SEFDs (SKA 304 Jy, MeerKAT 461 Jy, eta_c 0.95), ideal with no RFI flagging.
